text:
Ava: FYI CloudNova just sent a PO but it has two signers and asks for split-invoice handling. Marketplace portal only supports a single billing entity per PO. Need quick advice to close before EOD.
Sam: Do they require split payments or just separate invoice recipients?
Ava: Separate invoice recipients (two bill-to lines) under one PO number. They flagged it as a legal requirement for each business unit.
Priya: Finance: split-invoice for same PO is a pain for our AR. We can accept separate invoices reference the same PO if the marketplace flow allows multiple invoice recipients. Otherwise we need two POs.
Diego: Legal: if they insist both signers are required on a single PO, ask them to add an explicit clause in the SOW referencing consolidated invoicing + recipient list. That reduces our exposure.
Marta: Partnerships ops: vendor insists they can't generate 2 POs. Their accounting runs consolidated POs and then splits internally.
Sam: Options: 1) Accept single PO and internal work to emit two invoices referencing same PO (requires portal metadata change), 2) Ask vendor to submit two POs, 3) Manual workaround — we process off-portal with finance approval. Which is fastest?
Priya: Manual off-portal needs AP signoff and will delay payment terms. Not ideal.
Diego: If we do a temporary exception, we need a quick internal approval and a legal ack that invoice referencing same PO but different recipients is OK.
Ava: Can eng/product make a one-time portal metadata toggle to allow multiple invoice recipients for this PO?
CI Bot: @Sam triggered marketplace-config-check job #482: result=portal_schema_v3 — supports only single billing_contact field.
Sam: Thanks bot. Product change would be non-trivial but maybe a targeted support flag could be toggled for partner deals. Who can authorize?
Marta: I'll ping revenue ops and finance leadership. @Priya can you bias towards accepting same-PO invoices if CFO signs off?
Priya: I'll escalate to CFO. If CFO approves, finance can accept separate invoices referencing same PO with a note. Need legal note though.
Diego: I'll draft a short amendment template they can sign to accept consolidated PO with split invoices.
Ava: CloudNova rep said timeline is EOD. If we can get CFO + legal ack within 4 hours we'll accept. Otherwise we push to next week.
Sam: I'll open a fast-track deal desk ticket and mark as high priority.
Marta: Thanks — I'll update the CloudNova rep and ask for sample invoice XML snippet so legal can validate the reference fields.
Ava: CloudNova (via email): "We can provide invoice XML with <BillTo> entries for each BU and include the same PO number."
Diego: Perfect. Send me the sample XML and I'll confirm the amendment text.
Priya: CFO responded: conditional approval pending legal amendment.
Sam: Deal desk ticket created: DD-8921 — tagging finance + legal.
Marta: Noted. I'll keep CloudNova in the loop: tentative accept if amendment signed today. :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks team — will post final once legal + finance sign off.
